summary: @or-sdk/files preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js bundle
details: package.json declares preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (renamed identifiers, control-flow flattening), detects OS/arch/libc, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), unpacks and chmods it, then execFileSyncs bun against a shipped sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotated 1500+ entry string-array indirection scheme and hex-encoded identifiers; its name has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a Files API HTTP client). The install-time flow therefore executes an opaque, heavily obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on every `npm install`. Fetching Bun from its official project (oven-sh) does not make the code that runs under it trustworthy — the executed bytes are the shipped, obfuscated math_init.js, unrelated to the SDK's stated function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
